scope: Offline implementation acceptance; no live-market observation or provider-rights claim.
implemented: Durable normalized market-event capture for QUOTE, DEPTH, TICK, and BAR, gated by source- and event-kind-specific retention attestations.
Replay reconstructs normalized events in availability-time order and excludes records unavailable at the requested as-of time.
Kite historical minute bars are validated and archived with their retrieval time as availability, preventing retroactive lookahead claims.
Quote execution and fixture receipts expose exact quote input IDs, event hashes, timestamps, the selected quote ID on fills, and execution fidelity.
